description: Terrain that never came from a CityGML reader: a 3D GeoJSON quad typed dem:TINRelief with gml:id t1 through attributeKeys, triangulated by a Geometry Coercer set to Triangular Mesh. With no gmlPropertyName and no dem:lod given, the writer must settle the triangles onto dem:tin from the schema, write them as one gml:TriangulatedSurface of two triangles, and fill the required dem:lod with 0, the geometry's resolved LOD. New-world only: the legacy writer has no terrain support.
